// A large image split into a row-major grid of tiles for streaming and
// caching. Interior tiles are exactly TileSize; right/bottom edge tiles may
// be smaller.
type TiledImage
    implements IValue
{
    Size: IntegerSize2D;
    TileSize: IntegerSize2D;
    Tiles: Array<FloatImage>;
}
